biggest_catch: The $600 tier requires parking $25,000 for 83+ days. Bonus is not paid until the sixth month after account opening. Michigan primary-residence address required.
catches: Must be a new FMB personal checking customer; existing personal checking customers or those who closed an FMB personal checking account (primary or secondary) within 12 months of the offer start date (on or after 3/1/26) are not eligible.
Recipient's primary residence address must be in Michigan (P.O. boxes or owners of property in other eligible states do not qualify).
Open a new Prosper Plus Checking or Prosper Checking account between 3/1/26 and 12/31/26; ask an FMB banker to enroll you in the MIPROSPER Checking Offer or enter the promo code when opening online.

$600 tier: open a Prosper Plus Checking account, deposit at least $25,000 within the first 7 calendar days of account opening, AND maintain a minimum daily balance of $25,000 from the 8th through the 90th calendar day.
$400 tier: open a Prosper Checking account and establish a direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of opening.

Qualifying direct deposit is an electronic credit from an employer or outside agency; internal/external account transfers, Zelle deposits, and branch/ATM deposits do NOT qualify. Multiple smaller deposits do not satisfy the requirement.
Bonus credited to the new account in the sixth month following account opening ('New Checking Offer Reward').
Employees not eligible; not valid for Public Funds, Estate accounts, U.S. Government entities, other banks, or financial institutions.
